The Cleaning Equipment Zone in the Hall Closet. Parks the vacuum, broom, and mop so they come out in one motion and go back without a fight.

What done looks like:
1. The vacuum standing inside a taped floor outline with its cord wrapped
2. Every crevice tool
3. Brush head zipped in one bag clipped to its handle. Broom
4. Duster hanging handle-down from wall clips with the heads clear of the floor. The closet door swinging fully open without touching anything
